actual: After PR #4704, scripts/advisory_price_range_prepare_request.py --contract daily-envelope-v1 produces frozen_advisory_price_range_training_request_v2, but scripts/wsl/advisory_price_range_train.py unconditionally calls run_price_range_training_pipeline and validates FrozenAdvisoryPriceRangeTrainingRequestV1. The formal Advisory experiment fails before data projection/training with schema_version, label_policy_version, and entry_gap_condition validation errors. Add explicit fail-closed v1/v2 dispatch and direct regression coverage; do not change QE public code or experiment semantics.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
